data.long_meaning: Muayadah is a name derived from the Arabic root 'auwadah', which means 'to revive' or 'to re-awaken'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the name carries spiritual significance as a reminder to keep the faith alive and to inspire others to do the same. The name Muayadah carries the meaning “Reviver, Re-awakener” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muayadah usually hope their child will grow to embody reviver, re-awakener and live with faith, good character and purpose.
